If DGJTFLAG is 1, calculate the number of days late (DGJTDL) and call the DAYS and TOT1 routines.",

    "4d735e7f: If the 11th piece of DGJTNODE is 'TRANSCRIBED', set X1 to the 3rd piece of DGJTNODT, set X2 to the 2nd piece of DGJTPAR, calculate the difference between DGJTNOW and X2 using C^%DTC, set DGJTFLAG to 1 if the difference is not negative, call DAYS if DGJTFLAG is set, and call TOT1.",

    "a53db662: ;Get the number of days since 01/01/1700",
    "d1ecaa78: ;Calculate the number of days (in units of flths/wholes) that have elapsed since the last inspection and update the DGJTFLLG flag for use in TOT2",
    "93dfb691: ;If no DX terminal digit code is present but there is a valid node status, set the 2nd and 3rd decimal position digits, then quit.",
    "71f6de36: ;Otherwise, append the terminal digit code to the diagnosis ICD code being built and save it in DGJDICTO, also setting the 2nd decimal position digit.",
    "a694080a: ;If there is a non-admission movement update the total range, set DGJT3PC and increment DGJT2PC.",
    "f5f43f20: ;If there is a non-admission movement call the COD subroutine.",
    "ee1e7fd5: ;If there is a non-admission movement reset the start date and time and call the SET subroutine.",
    "fb4b18dc: ;Exit the routine.",
    "db7bbb90: ;Get the code associated with the movement from the DGPM, DGPT and DGP files.",
    "90d2190a: Set a flag indicating that X contains double quotes",
    "5a8d5039: Exit the routine",
    "294e4a1b: Concatenate X to DGJCOTO. If the double quote flag is set, append an asterisk to DGJT4PC after concatenating X. If the double quote flag is not set, just concatenate X to DGJT4PC. Increment DGJT3PC by 1"
